title: stepback_native_json_v1
description: Stable schema for the stepback native JSON export format produced by stepback.export_native_json. The format is a single JSON object carrying a format tag, an optional recorder-metadata header, and a lossless array of recorded step dicts.

format.description: Format discriminator. Must be exactly 'stepback_native_json_v1' for v1 files.

header.description: Optional recorder metadata copied verbatim from the .sb trace header. All fields are advisory and consumers must tolerate unknown keys.

steps.description: Ordered array of recorded step dicts. Each entry is a verbatim canonical-JSON step as recorded in the .sb trace.

step.description: One recorded step. Contains at minimum step_id and step_kind; all other fields are optional and preserved verbatim from the trace.

step_id.description: ULID, monotonic per trace. Primary key for the step.

step_kind.description: Discriminator for the step payload. Known v1 values are listed in x-knownValues; unknown values are passed through for forward compatibility.

parent_step_id.description: Parent edge in the call tree. Null for the root step.

parent_step_ids.description: Multi-parent edges; set only on parallel_branch_join steps.

inputs.description: Canonical-JSON-encodable input payload. Structure varies by step_kind.

outputs.description: Canonical-JSON-encodable output payload. Structure varies by step_kind.

nondeterminism.description: Recorded non-deterministic inputs (rng seeds, wallclock, env, network, model_provider).

wallclock_ns.description: Step wallclock at write time, ns since Unix epoch.

cpu_ns.description: Cumulative CPU time consumed by this step, in ns.

cost_usd.description: Cost from pinned price_list_version, in USD.

llm_request.description: Exact LLM request dict (model, messages, sampling params, tool spec). Present on llm_call steps.

llm_response.description: Exact LLM response dict. Present on llm_call steps.

tool_name.description: Tool identifier. Present on tool_call and mcp_call steps.

policy_decision.description: Enforcement / audit decision payload. Present on policy_check steps.

router_decision.description: Router decision payload. Present on router steps.

branch_id.description: Identifier for parallel branches; set on parallel_branch_open and steps inside the branch.

branch_ids.description: Branch ids being joined. Set on parallel_branch_join steps.

exception.description: Exception payload (type, message, traceback). Present on exception steps.

metadata.description: Free-form recorder metadata. Opaque to the spec.

tags.description: Free-form string tags. Opaque to the spec.
